context: Tests current AEM EDS loading-phase knowledge: third-party analytics belongs behind the boilerplate consent gate (consent-check.js -> consented.js), not in a delayed.js file or the eager/lazy phases; and a block likely to sit in the first section is loaded before LCP, so its decoration must not block rendering on network work.

checklist.name: Analytics loaded from consented.js
checklist.description: The analytics script is loaded from `scripts/consented.js` (or code it imports), so it runs only after consent; the consent gate in `consent-check.js` stays in place

checklist.name: No delayed.js
checklist.description: The solution does NOT create or reference a `scripts/delayed.js` file and does NOT add a timer-based delayed loader

checklist.name: Analytics not in eager or lazy phase
checklist.description: The analytics tag is NOT added to `head.html`, `loadEager`, `loadLazy`, or at module top level in `scripts.js`

checklist.name: aem.js not modified
checklist.description: The solution does NOT modify or overwrite `scripts/aem.js`

checklist.name: Block at standard path with default export
checklist.description: The block JS is at `blocks/promo-banner/promo-banner.js` and default-exports a `decorate(block)` function

checklist.name: Authored content rendered without waiting on fetch
checklist.description: The authored picture and heading are kept (moved or left in place, not recreated) and are not hidden or held back until `/promo.json` responds; decorate does not `await` the fetch before the authored content is in its final position

checklist.name: Promo fetch is non-blocking and handles failure
checklist.description: The `/promo.json` request runs without blocking decoration (e.g., not awaited in decorate, or started after render) and handles a failed or invalid response without throwing

checklist.name: Notes explain first-section loading
checklist.description: NOTES.md states that a block at the top of the page loads in the first section before LCP (or equivalent), which is why the fetch must not block rendering

checklist.name: Notes explain consent placement
checklist.description: NOTES.md states that analytics is loaded via the consent gate (consented.js), not eagerly
